localizations.name: Tidebreaker EMP Skirmisher
localizations.description: High-speed amphibious hovercraft equipped with pulsed EMP disruptors that stun enemy targets on impact.
localizations.skillDescription: Fires an EMP overcharge pulse at the target area, disrupting enemy units.

localizations.name: Escaramuzador EMP Tidebreaker
localizations.description: Aerodeslizador anfibio de alta velocidad equipado con disruptores EMP que aturden a los objetivos al impactar.
localizations.skillDescription: Dispara un pulso de sobrecarga EMP en el área objetivo para desestabilizar unidades enemigas.

localizations.name: Tidebreaker Hover Foundry
localizations.description: Manufactures amphibious Tidebreaker EMP Skirmishers.

localizations.name: Fundición de aerodeslizadores Tidebreaker
localizations.description: Fabrica escaramuzadores EMP anfibios Tidebreaker.

localizations.name: Salvage Field Repair Hauler
localizations.description: Armored logistics crawler outfitted with autonomous nanite repair systems to maintain friendly units and production facilities.
localizations.skillDescription: Emits a nanite repair pulse that restores nearby allied units and structures.

localizations.name: Transporte de reparación en campo Salvage
localizations.description: Oruga logística blindada equipada con sistemas nanorrobóticos autónomos para reparar unidades e instalaciones de producción aliadas.
localizations.skillDescription: Emite un pulso nanorrobótico que repara unidades y estructuras aliadas cercanas.

localizations.name: Salvage Logistics Works
localizations.description: Manufactures Salvage Field Repair Haulers.

localizations.name: Talleres logísticos Salvage
localizations.description: Fabrica transportes de reparación en campo Salvage.

localizations.name: Skyguard Mobile SAM Platform
localizations.description: Heavy surface-to-air missile platform with precision targeting and long-range payload delivery, vulnerable to close-range assaults.
localizations.skillDescription: Launches a precision missile salvo at the target location.

localizations.name: Plataforma SAM móvil Skyguard
localizations.description: Plataforma pesada de misiles tierra-aire con puntería de precisión y largo alcance, vulnerable a asaltos a quemarropa.
localizations.skillDescription: Lanza una salva de misiles de precisión sobre la ubicación objetivo.

localizations.name: Skyguard Missile Works
localizations.description: Produces Skyguard Mobile SAM Platforms.

localizations.name: Fábrica de misiles Skyguard
localizations.description: Produce plataformas SAM móviles Skyguard.

localizations.name: Bulwark Siege Tank
localizations.description: Heavily armored siege platform with long-range artillery bombardment capability. Slow but devastating.
localizations.skillDescription: Unleashes a heavy artillery barrage across the target area.

localizations.name: Tanque de asedio Bulwark
localizations.description: Plataforma de asedio fuertemente blindada con capacidad de bombardeo de artilleria de largo alcance. Lenta pero devastadora.
localizations.skillDescription: Desata un bombardeo de artillería pesada sobre el área objetivo.

localizations.name: Bulwark Siege Foundry
localizations.description: Manufactures heavy Bulwark Siege Tanks.

localizations.name: Fundicion de asedio Bulwark
localizations.description: Fabrica tanques de asedio pesados Bulwark.

localizations.name: Arc Lance Walker
localizations.description: Bipedal mech armed with a high-energy arc lance that chains between targets. Agile and deadly at mid-range.
localizations.skillDescription: Discharges a high-voltage arc lance strike at the target enemy.

localizations.name: Caminante de lanza de arco
localizations.description: Meca bipedo armado con una lanza de arco de alta energia que se encadena entre objetivos. Agil y letal a media distancia.
localizations.skillDescription: Descarga un impacto de lanza de arco de alto voltaje contra el objetivo enemigo.

localizations.name: Arc Lance Assembly Bay
localizations.description: Assembles Arc Lance Walker mechs.

localizations.name: Bahia de ensamblaje Arc Lance
localizations.description: Ensambla mecas caminantes Arc Lance.

localizations.name: Field Medic Rover
localizations.description: Fast wheeled support vehicle with autonomous nanite healing systems. Repairs allies and suppresses enemies with light weaponry.
localizations.skillDescription: Triggers an emergency nanite pulse that heals nearby allied units.

localizations.name: Rover medico de campo
localizations.description: Vehiculo de apoyo sobre ruedas rapido con sistemas de curacion nanorroboticos autonomos. Repara aliados y suprime enemigos con armamento ligero.
localizations.skillDescription: Activa un pulso nanorrobótico de emergencia que repara unidades aliadas cercanas.

localizations.name: Field Medic Bay
localizations.description: Manufactures Field Medic Rovers.

localizations.name: Bahia medica de campo
localizations.description: Fabrica rovers medicos de campo.

localizations.name: Sentinel Relay
localizations.description: A bounded support rover that restores shields, repairs nearby allies, and keeps a small squad alive.
localizations.skillDescription: Emits a nanite repair pulse around itself.

localizations.name: Relé Centinela
localizations.description: Rover de apoyo limitado que restaura escudos, repara aliados cercanos y mantiene vivo a un escuadrón pequeño.
localizations.skillDescription: Emite un pulso de reparación nanite a su alrededor.

localizations.name: Sentinel Relay Bay
localizations.description: Manufactures Sentinel Relay support rovers.

localizations.name: Bahía del Relé Centinela
localizations.description: Fabrica rovers de apoyo Relé Centinela.

localizations.name: Gravitas Breaker
localizations.description: An armored frontline breaker that attracts hostile fire and overloads its shield in close combat.
localizations.skillDescription: Detonates a shield overload nova at the target area.

localizations.name: Rompegravedad
localizations.description: Rompedor blindado de primera línea que atrae el fuego hostil y sobrecarga su escudo en combate cercano.
localizations.skillDescription: Detona una nova de sobrecarga de escudo en el área objetivo.

localizations.name: Gravitas Breaker Foundry
localizations.description: Manufactures Gravitas Breaker frontline tanks.

localizations.name: Fundición Rompegravedad
localizations.description: Fabrica tanques de primera línea Rompegravedad.

localizations.name: Command Relay
localizations.description: A command vehicle that coordinates nearby attackers while retaining a bounded combat role.
localizations.skillDescription: Issues a coordinated command strike at the target location.

localizations.name: Relé de Mando
localizations.description: Vehículo de mando que coordina atacantes cercanos y conserva un papel de combate limitado.
localizations.skillDescription: Emite una orden de ataque coordinado en la ubicación objetivo.

localizations.name: Command Relay Motor Pool
localizations.description: Manufactures Command Relay vehicles.

localizations.name: Parque del Relé de Mando
localizations.description: Fabrica vehículos Relé de Mando.
